{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `localExecution: true` SM rule fails when its `postJSAction` requires a shared helper module — live on `story_ba_check`, whose PO Review → BA Analysis rung is dead on every SM pass with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function`.

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js` `runLocalAction` (lines 828–878) executes localExecution postJS modules in-process by reading their source and eval-ing it inside a hand-rolled sandbox. The sandbox pre-builds only three modules — `config.js` (`_cm`), `common/scm.js` (`_scm`), `configLoader.js` (`_cl`) — and the action-module `require` shim (lines 864–868) resolves **only** the exact ids `./configLoader.js`/`./configLoader` and any id containing `scm.js`. Every other id falls through the catch-all `return _cm.exports`, silently handing the action the `config.js` exports object. `js/checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` (migrated to the tracker layer in 2db92c99/ebc54801) requires `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js` at lines 17–18; both ids hit the catch-all, so `trackersModule.createTracker` is `undefined` and the first member call throws at line 28. The same silent-fallthrough applies to the whole verified require closure of the 13 postJS scripts behind the 15 localExecution rules: `common/trackers.js`, `common/tokenUsageComment.js`, `common/ticketKeyShapes.js` (transitive), `common/autoStart.js`, `common/aiChat.js`, `common/buildEncodedConfig.js` (transitive), `common/validateInputJql.js` (transitive). The catch-all also swallows typo'd require ids — the failure only surfaces at first member call, which is why it is silent at load time.

**Impact**: `story_ba_check` never moves PO Review stories to BA Analysis (SM logs `❌ Local execution failed for <KEY>` at `js/smAgent.js:1022`); the remaining localExecution rules (`retry_merge`, `retry_merge_test`, `bug_merged`, …) fail on the same path as soon as they fire. {"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `localExecution: true` SM rule fails when its `postJSAction` requires a shared helper module — live on `story_ba_check`, whose PO Review → BA Analysis rung is dead on every SM pass with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function`.

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js` `runLocalAction` (lines 828–878) executes localExecution postJS modules in-process by reading their source and eval-ing it inside a hand-rolled sandbox. The sandbox pre-builds only three modules — `config.js` (`_cm`), `common/scm.js` (`_scm`), `configLoader.js` (`_cl`) — and the action-module `require` shim (lines 864–868) resolves **only** the exact ids `./configLoader.js`/`./configLoader` and any id containing `scm.js`. Every other id falls through the catch-all `return _cm.exports`, silently handing the action the `config.js` exports object. `js/checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` (migrated to the tracker layer in 2db92c99/ebc54801) requires `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js` at lines 17–18; both ids hit the catch-all, so `trackersModule.createTracker` is `undefined` and the first member call throws at line 28. The same silent-fallthrough applies to the whole verified require closure of the 13 postJS scripts behind the 15 localExecution rules: `common/trackers.js`, `common/tokenUsageComment.js`, `common/ticketKeyShapes.js` (transitive), `common/autoStart.js`, `common/aiChat.js`, `common/buildEncodedConfig.js` (transitive), `common/validateInputJql.js` (transitive). The catch-all also swallows typo'd require ids — the failure only surfaces at first member call, which is why it is silent at load time.

**Impact**: `story_ba_check` never moves PO Review stories to BA Analysis (SM logs `❌ Local execution failed for <KEY>` at `js/smAgent.js:1022`); the remaining localExecution rules (`retry_merge`, `retry_merge_test`, `bug_merged`, …) fail on the same path as soon as they fire. No non-localExecution behavior is affected.

**Fix approach** (route A from the ticket — extend the sandbox, minimal diff): in `runLocalAction`, read the seven helper sources with the same dual-read CWD fallback pattern already used for `config.js`/`scm.js` (`agents/js/common/<m>` then `js/common/<m>`), in dependency order (`ticketKeyShapes.js`, `trackers.js`, `tokenUsageComment.js`, `aiChat.js`, `validateInputJql.js`, `buildEncodedConfig.js`, `autoStart.js`); wrap each as its own `(function(module, exports, require){…})` module with a shared require shim; extend the action require shim with a substring check per helper **before** the `_cm.exports` catch-all (which stays for backwards compat). Unmatched ids keep receiving `config.js` exports; an unreadable helper source fails fast with `Cannot read: <module>` like the existing guards; a helper that throws at load surfaces an error naming the module.

**Scope decisions**:
- `aiChat` + `autoStart`/`buildEncodedConfig`/`validateInputJql` ship in the same change as the tracker trio (ticket open question 1 — 7 reads + wrapper blocks, no added risk).
- `scm.js`'s own require of `./machineNotice.js` (gh-808) still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. Not extended: `machineNotice` is only used by `scm.fetchDiscussions`, and no localExecution-reachable code path calls `fetchDiscussions` (its callers are preCli/post scripts that run through the normal module-dir-correct loader). Recorded here as an adjacent gap for route B (drop the sandbox, use the real loader).
- `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`) — it had zero unit-test coverage.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket.
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `localExecution: true` SM rule fails when its `postJSAction` requires a shared helper module — live on `story_ba_check`, whose PO Review → BA Analysis rung is dead on every SM pass with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function`.

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js` `runLocalAction` (lines 828–878) executes localExecution postJS modules in-process by reading their source and eval-ing it inside a hand-rolled sandbox. The sandbox pre-builds only three modules — `config.js` (`_cm`), `common/scm.js` (`_scm`), `configLoader.js` (`_cl`) — and the action-module `require` shim (lines 864–868) resolves **only** the exact ids `./configLoader.js`/`./configLoader` and any id containing `scm.js`. Every other id falls through the catch-all `return _cm.exports`, silently handing the action the `config.js` exports object. `js/checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` (migrated to the tracker layer in 2db92c99/ebc54801) requires `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js` at lines 17–18; both ids hit the catch-all, so `trackersModule.createTracker` is `undefined` and the first member call throws at line 28. The same silent-fallthrough applies to the whole verified require closure of the 13 postJS scripts behind the 15 localExecution rules: `common/trackers.js`, `common/tokenUsageComment.js`, `common/ticketKeyShapes.js` (transitive), `common/autoStart.js`, `common/aiChat.js`, `common/buildEncodedConfig.js` (transitive), `common/validateInputJql.js` (transitive). The catch-all also swallows typo'd require ids — the failure only surfaces at first member call, which is why it is silent at load time.

**Impact**: `story_ba_check` never moves PO Review stories to BA Analysis (SM logs `❌ Local execution failed for <KEY>` at `js/smAgent.js:1022`); the remaining localExecution rules (`retry_merge`, `retry_merge_test`, `bug_merged`, …) fail on the same path as soon as they fire. No non-localExecution behavior is affected.

**Fix approach** (route A from the ticket — extend the sandbox, minimal diff): in `runLocalAction`, read the seven helper sources with the same dual-read CWD fallback pattern already used for `config.js`/`scm.js` (`agents/js/common/<m>` then `js/common/<m>`), in dependency order (`ticketKeyShapes.js`, `trackers.js`, `tokenUsageComment.js`, `aiChat.js`, `validateInputJql.js`, `buildEncodedConfig.js`, `autoStart.js`); wrap each as its own `(function(module, exports, require){…})` module with a shared require shim; extend the action require shim with a substring check per helper **before** the `_cm.exports` catch-all (which stays for backwards compat). Unmatched ids keep receiving `config.js` exports; an unreadable helper source fails fast with `Cannot read: <module>` like the existing guards; a helper that throws at load surfaces an error naming the module.

**Scope decisions**:
- `aiChat` + `autoStart`/`buildEncodedConfig`/`validateInputJql` ship in the same change as the tracker trio (ticket open question 1 — 7 reads + wrapper blocks, no added risk).
- `scm.js`'s own require of `./machineNotice.js` (gh-808) still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. Not extended: `machineNotice` is only used by `scm.fetchDiscussions`, and no localExecution-reachable code path calls `fetchDiscussions` (its callers are preCli/post scripts that run through the normal module-dir-correct loader). Recorded here as an adjacent gap for route B (drop the sandbox, use the real loader).
- `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`) — it had zero unit-test coverage.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket.
"}

arguments.content:
### Root Cause

`runLocalAction` in `js/smAgent.js` executes `localExecution: true` postJS actions inside a hand-rolled eval sandbox whose `require` shim only resolved `./configLoader.js` and ids containing `scm.js`; every other id silently fell through to the `config.js` exports. Actions migrated to the tracker layer (`checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` → `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js`) therefore got the wrong module and died on the first member call — `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function` — killing the `story_ba_check` PO Review → BA Analysis hand-off on every SM pass, and pre-breaking every other localExecution rule (`retry_merge`, `bug_merged`, …).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` (`runLocalAction`): read the seven helper sources with the existing dual-read CWD pattern (`agents/js/common/<m>` → `js/common/<m>`) in dependency order — `ticketKeyShapes`, `trackers`, `tokenUsageComment`, `aiChat`, `validateInputJql`, `buildEncodedConfig`, `autoStart` — wrap each as its own sandbox module, and resolve their ids explicitly in a shared require shim before the `config.js` catch-all (kept for backwards compat). Unreadable helper → fail fast `Cannot read: <module>`; helper throwing at load → error names the module. `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`).

### Test Coverage

- New suite `smAgent: runLocalAction require shim (gh-908)` in `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js` (7 tests): tracker-layer resolution (UT-1), `agents/` layout (UT-1b/AC4), autoStart/aiChat/transitive chains (UT-2), unknown-id `config.js` fallback unchanged (UT-3/AC3), live `checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` end-to-end through the sandbox with mocked `jira_*` (IT-1), load-error naming (E3), unreadable-source fail-fast (E4).
- Reproduction confirmed RED before the fix (UT-1/UT-2/IT-1 failed with the live `not a function` signature), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — all green (result pinned in CI).

### Notes

- No behavior change outside `runLocalAction`: the sandbox catch-all still returns `config.js` exports for unknown ids (AC3), and the `scm.js`/`configLoader.js` handling is untouched.
- Known adjacent gap, intentionally not extended: `scm.js`'s own `require('./machineNotice.js')` still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. It is only reachable via `fetchDiscussions`, which no localExecution-reachable code calls today; the durable fix is route B (run localExecution actions through the normal module-dir-correct loader).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `localExecution: true` SM rule fails when its `postJSAction` requires a shared helper module — live on `story_ba_check`, whose PO Review → BA Analysis rung is dead on every SM pass with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function`.

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js` `runLocalAction` (lines 828–878) executes localExecution postJS modules in-process by reading their source and eval-ing it inside a hand-rolled sandbox. The sandbox pre-builds only three modules — `config.js` (`_cm`), `common/scm.js` (`_scm`), `configLoader.js` (`_cl`) — and the action-module `require` shim (lines 864–868) resolves **only** the exact ids `./configLoader.js`/`./configLoader` and any id containing `scm.js`. Every other id falls through the catch-all `return _cm.exports`, silently handing the action the `config.js` exports object. `js/checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` (migrated to the tracker layer in 2db92c99/ebc54801) requires `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js` at lines 17–18; both ids hit the catch-all, so `trackersModule.createTracker` is `undefined` and the first member call throws at line 28. The same silent-fallthrough applies to the whole verified require closure of the 13 postJS scripts behind the 15 localExecution rules: `common/trackers.js`, `common/tokenUsageComment.js`, `common/ticketKeyShapes.js` (transitive), `common/autoStart.js`, `common/aiChat.js`, `common/buildEncodedConfig.js` (transitive), `common/validateInputJql.js` (transitive). `runLocalAction` in `js/smAgent.js` executes `localExecution: true` postJS actions inside a hand-rolled eval sandbox whose `require` shim only resolved `./configLoader.js` and ids containing `scm.js`; every other id silently fell through to the `config.js` exports. ### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` (`runLocalAction`): read the seven helper sources with the existing dual-read CWD pattern (`agents/js/common/<m>` → `js/common/<m>`) in dependency order — `ticketKeyShapes`, `trackers`, `tokenUsageComment`, `aiChat`, `validateInputJql`, `buildEncodedConfig`, `autoStart` — wrap each as its own sandbox module, and resolve their ids explicitly in a shared require shim before the `config.js` catch-all (kept for backwards compat). Unreadable helper → fail fast `Cannot read: <module>`; helper throwing at load → error names the module. `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`).

### Test Coverage

- New suite `smAgent: runLocalAction require shim (gh-908)` in `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js` (7 tests): tracker-layer resolution (UT-1), `agents/` layout (UT-1b/AC4), autoStart/aiChat/transitive chains (UT-2), unknown-id `config.js` fallback unchanged (UT-3/AC3), live `checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` end-to-end through the sandbox with mocked `jira_*` (IT-1), load-error naming (E3), unreadable-source fail-fast (E4).
- Reproduction confirmed RED before the fix (UT-1/UT-2/IT-1 failed with the live `not a function` signature), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — all green (result pinned in CI).

### Notes

- No behavior change outside `runLocalAction`: the sandbox catch-all still returns `config.js` exports for unknown ids (AC3), and the `scm.js`/`configLoader.js` handling is untouched.
- Known adjacent gap, intentionally not extended: `scm.js`'s own `require('./machineNotice.js')` still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. {"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `localExecution: true` SM rule fails when its `postJSAction` requires a shared helper module — live on `story_ba_check`, whose PO Review → BA Analysis rung is dead on every SM pass with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function`.

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js` `runLocalAction` (lines 828–878) executes localExecution postJS modules in-process by reading their source and eval-ing it inside a hand-rolled sandbox. The sandbox pre-builds only three modules — `config.js` (`_cm`), `common/scm.js` (`_scm`), `configLoader.js` (`_cl`) — and the action-module `require` shim (lines 864–868) resolves **only** the exact ids `./configLoader.js`/`./configLoader` and any id containing `scm.js`. Every other id falls through the catch-all `return _cm.exports`, silently handing the action the `config.js` exports object. `js/checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` (migrated to the tracker layer in 2db92c99/ebc54801) requires `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js` at lines 17–18; both ids hit the catch-all, so `trackersModule.createTracker` is `undefined` and the first member call throws at line 28. The same silent-fallthrough applies to the whole verified require closure of the 13 postJS scripts behind the 15 localExecution rules: `common/trackers.js`, `common/tokenUsageComment.js`, `common/ticketKeyShapes.js` (transitive), `common/autoStart.js`, `common/aiChat.js`, `common/buildEncodedConfig.js` (transitive), `common/validateInputJql.js` (transitive). The catch-all also swallows typo'd require ids — the failure only surfaces at first member call, which is why it is silent at load time.

**Impact**: `story_ba_check` never moves PO Review stories to BA Analysis (SM logs `❌ Local execution failed for <KEY>` at `js/smAgent.js:1022`); the remaining localExecution rules (`retry_merge`, `retry_merge_test`, `bug_merged`, …) fail on the same path as soon as they fire. No non-localExecution behavior is affected.

**Fix approach** (route A from the ticket — extend the sandbox, minimal diff): in `runLocalAction`, read the seven helper sources with the same dual-read CWD fallback pattern already used for `config.js`/`scm.js` (`agents/js/common/<m>` then `js/common/<m>`), in dependency order (`ticketKeyShapes.js`, `trackers.js`, `tokenUsageComment.js`, `aiChat.js`, `validateInputJql.js`, `buildEncodedConfig.js`, `autoStart.js`); wrap each as its own `(function(module, exports, require){…})` module with a shared require shim; extend the action require shim with a substring check per helper **before** the `_cm.exports` catch-all (which stays for backwards compat). Unmatched ids keep receiving `config.js` exports; an unreadable helper source fails fast with `Cannot read: <module>` like the existing guards; a helper that throws at load surfaces an error naming the module.

**Scope decisions**:
- `aiChat` + `autoStart`/`buildEncodedConfig`/`validateInputJql` ship in the same change as the tracker trio (ticket open question 1 — 7 reads + wrapper blocks, no added risk).
- `scm.js`'s own require of `./machineNotice.js` (gh-808) still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. Not extended: `machineNotice` is only used by `scm.fetchDiscussions`, and no localExecution-reachable code path calls `fetchDiscussions` (its callers are preCli/post scripts that run through the normal module-dir-correct loader). Recorded here as an adjacent gap for route B (drop the sandbox, use the real loader).
- `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`) — it had zero unit-test coverage.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`runLocalAction` in `js/smAgent.js` executes `localExecution: true` postJS actions inside a hand-rolled eval sandbox whose `require` shim only resolved `./configLoader.js` and ids containing `scm.js`; every other id silently fell through to the `config.js` exports. Actions migrated to the tracker layer (`checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` → `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js`) therefore got the wrong module and died on the first member call — `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function` — killing the `story_ba_check` PO Review → BA Analysis hand-off on every SM pass, and pre-breaking every other localExecution rule (`retry_merge`, `bug_merged`, …).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` (`runLocalAction`): read the seven helper sources with the existing dual-read CWD pattern (`agents/js/common/<m>` → `js/common/<m>`) in dependency order — `ticketKeyShapes`, `trackers`, `tokenUsageComment`, `aiChat`, `validateInputJql`, `buildEncodedConfig`, `autoStart` — wrap each as its own sandbox module, and resolve their ids explicitly in a shared require shim before the `config.js` catch-all (kept for backwards compat). Unreadable helper → fail fast `Cannot read: <module>`; helper throwing at load → error names the module. `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`).

### Test Coverage

- New suite `smAgent: runLocalAction require shim (gh-908)` in `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js` (7 tests): tracker-layer resolution (UT-1), `agents/` layout (UT-1b/AC4), autoStart/aiChat/transitive chains (UT-2), unknown-id `config.js` fallback unchanged (UT-3/AC3), live `checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` end-to-end through the sandbox with mocked `jira_*` (IT-1), load-error naming (E3), unreadable-source fail-fast (E4).
- Reproduction confirmed RED before the fix (UT-1/UT-2/IT-1 failed with the live `not a function` signature), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — all green (result pinned in CI).

### Notes

- No behavior change outside `runLocalAction`: the sandbox catch-all still returns `config.js` exports for unknown ids (AC3), and the `scm.js`/`configLoader.js` handling is untouched.
- Known adjacent gap, intentionally not extended: `scm.js`'s own `require('./machineNotice.js')` still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. It is only reachable via `fetchDiscussions`, which no localExecution-reachable code calls today; the durable fix is route B (run localExecution actions through the normal module-dir-correct loader).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `localExecution: true` SM rule fails when its `postJSAction` requires a shared helper module — live on `story_ba_check`, whose PO Review → BA Analysis rung is dead on every SM pass with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function`.

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js` `runLocalAction` (lines 828–878) executes localExecution postJS modules in-process by reading their source and eval-ing it inside a hand-rolled sandbox. The sandbox pre-builds only three modules — `config.js` (`_cm`), `common/scm.js` (`_scm`), `configLoader.js` (`_cl`) — and the action-module `require` shim (lines 864–868) resolves **only** the exact ids `./configLoader.js`/`./configLoader` and any id containing `scm.js`. Every other id falls through the catch-all `return _cm.exports`, silently handing the action the `config.js` exports object. `js/checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` (migrated to the tracker layer in 2db92c99/ebc54801) requires `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js` at lines 17–18; both ids hit the catch-all, so `trackersModule.createTracker` is `undefined` and the first member call throws at line 28. The same silent-fallthrough applies to the whole verified require closure of the 13 postJS scripts behind the 15 localExecution rules: `common/trackers.js`, `common/tokenUsageComment.js`, `common/ticketKeyShapes.js` (transitive), `common/autoStart.js`, `common/aiChat.js`, `common/buildEncodedConfig.js` (transitive), `common/validateInputJql.js` (transitive). The catch-all also swallows typo'd require ids — the failure only surfaces at first member call, which is why it is silent at load time.

**Impact**: `story_ba_check` never moves PO Review stories to BA Analysis (SM logs `❌ Local execution failed for <KEY>` at `js/smAgent.js:1022`); the remaining localExecution rules (`retry_merge`, `retry_merge_test`, `bug_merged`, …) fail on the same path as soon as they fire. No non-localExecution behavior is affected.

**Fix approach** (route A from the ticket — extend the sandbox, minimal diff): in `runLocalAction`, read the seven helper sources with the same dual-read CWD fallback pattern already used for `config.js`/`scm.js` (`agents/js/common/<m>` then `js/common/<m>`), in dependency order (`ticketKeyShapes.js`, `trackers.js`, `tokenUsageComment.js`, `aiChat.js`, `validateInputJql.js`, `buildEncodedConfig.js`, `autoStart.js`); wrap each as its own `(function(module, exports, require){…})` module with a shared require shim; extend the action require shim with a substring check per helper **before** the `_cm.exports` catch-all (which stays for backwards compat). Unmatched ids keep receiving `config.js` exports; an unreadable helper source fails fast with `Cannot read: <module>` like the existing guards; a helper that throws at load surfaces an error naming the module.

**Scope decisions**:
- `aiChat` + `autoStart`/`buildEncodedConfig`/`validateInputJql` ship in the same change as the tracker trio (ticket open question 1 — 7 reads + wrapper blocks, no added risk).
- `scm.js`'s own require of `./machineNotice.js` (gh-808) still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. Not extended: `machineNotice` is only used by `scm.fetchDiscussions`, and no localExecution-reachable code path calls `fetchDiscussions` (its callers are preCli/post scripts that run through the normal module-dir-correct loader). Recorded here as an adjacent gap for route B (drop the sandbox, use the real loader).
- `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`) — it had zero unit-test coverage.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`runLocalAction` in `js/smAgent.js` executes `localExecution: true` postJS actions inside a hand-rolled eval sandbox whose `require` shim only resolved `./configLoader.js` and ids containing `scm.js`; every other id silently fell through to the `config.js` exports. Actions migrated to the tracker layer (`checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` → `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js`) therefore got the wrong module and died on the first member call — `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function` — killing the `story_ba_check` PO Review → BA Analysis hand-off on every SM pass, and pre-breaking every other localExecution rule (`retry_merge`, `bug_merged`, …).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` (`runLocalAction`): read the seven helper sources with the existing dual-read CWD pattern (`agents/js/common/<m>` → `js/common/<m>`) in dependency order — `ticketKeyShapes`, `trackers`, `tokenUsageComment`, `aiChat`, `validateInputJql`, `buildEncodedConfig`, `autoStart` — wrap each as its own sandbox module, and resolve their ids explicitly in a shared require shim before the `config.js` catch-all (kept for backwards compat). Unreadable helper → fail fast `Cannot read: <module>`; helper throwing at load → error names the module. `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`).

### Test Coverage

- New suite `smAgent: runLocalAction require shim (gh-908)` in `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js` (7 tests): tracker-layer resolution (UT-1), `agents/` layout (UT-1b/AC4), autoStart/aiChat/transitive chains (UT-2), unknown-id `config.js` fallback unchanged (UT-3/AC3), live `checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` end-to-end through the sandbox with mocked `jira_*` (IT-1), load-error naming (E3), unreadable-source fail-fast (E4).
- Reproduction confirmed RED before the fix (UT-1/UT-2/IT-1 failed with the live `not a function` signature), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — all green (result pinned in CI).

### Notes

- No behavior change outside `runLocalAction`: the sandbox catch-all still returns `config.js` exports for unknown ids (AC3), and the `scm.js`/`configLoader.js` handling is untouched.
- Known adjacent gap, intentionally not extended: `scm.js`'s own `require('./machineNotice.js')` still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. It is only reachable via `fetchDiscussions`, which no localExecution-reachable code calls today; the durable fix is route B (run localExecution actions through the normal module-dir-correct loader).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `localExecution: true` SM rule fails when its `postJSAction` requires a shared helper module — live on `story_ba_check`, whose PO Review → BA Analysis rung is dead on every SM pass with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function`.

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js` `runLocalAction` (lines 828–878) executes localExecution postJS modules in-process by reading their source and eval-ing it inside a hand-rolled sandbox. The sandbox pre-builds only three modules — `config.js` (`_cm`), `common/scm.js` (`_scm`), `configLoader.js` (`_cl`) — and the action-module `require` shim (lines 864–868) resolves **only** the exact ids `./configLoader.js`/`./configLoader` and any id containing `scm.js`. Every other id falls through the catch-all `return _cm.exports`, silently handing the action the `config.js` exports object. `js/checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` (migrated to the tracker layer in 2db92c99/ebc54801) requires `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js` at lines 17–18; both ids hit the catch-all, so `trackersModule.createTracker` is `undefined` and the first member call throws at line 28. The same silent-fallthrough applies to the whole verified require closure of the 13 postJS scripts behind the 15 localExecution rules: `common/trackers.js`, `common/tokenUsageComment.js`, `common/ticketKeyShapes.js` (transitive), `common/autoStart.js`, `common/aiChat.js`, `common/buildEncodedConfig.js` (transitive), `common/validateInputJql.js` (transitive). The catch-all also swallows typo'd require ids — the failure only surfaces at first member call, which is why it is silent at load time.

**Impact**: `story_ba_check` never moves PO Review stories to BA Analysis (SM logs `❌ Local execution failed for <KEY>` at `js/smAgent.js:1022`); the remaining localExecution rules (`retry_merge`, `retry_merge_test`, `bug_merged`, …) fail on the same path as soon as they fire. No non-localExecution behavior is affected.

**Fix approach** (route A from the ticket — extend the sandbox, minimal diff): in `runLocalAction`, read the seven helper sources with the same dual-read CWD fallback pattern already used for `config.js`/`scm.js` (`agents/js/common/<m>` then `js/common/<m>`), in dependency order (`ticketKeyShapes.js`, `trackers.js`, `tokenUsageComment.js`, `aiChat.js`, `validateInputJql.js`, `buildEncodedConfig.js`, `autoStart.js`); wrap each as its own `(function(module, exports, require){…})` module with a shared require shim; extend the action require shim with a substring check per helper **before** the `_cm.exports` catch-all (which stays for backwards compat). Unmatched ids keep receiving `config.js` exports; an unreadable helper source fails fast with `Cannot read: <module>` like the existing guards; a helper that throws at load surfaces an error naming the module.

**Scope decisions**:
- `aiChat` + `autoStart`/`buildEncodedConfig`/`validateInputJql` ship in the same change as the tracker trio (ticket open question 1 — 7 reads + wrapper blocks, no added risk).
- `scm.js`'s own require of `./machineNotice.js` (gh-808) still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. Not extended: `machineNotice` is only used by `scm.fetchDiscussions`, and no localExecution-reachable code path calls `fetchDiscussions` (its callers are preCli/post scripts that run through the normal module-dir-correct loader). Recorded here as an adjacent gap for route B (drop the sandbox, use the real loader).
- `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`) — it had zero unit-test coverage.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket.
"}

{"content":"### Root Cause

`runLocalAction` in `js/smAgent.js` executes `localExecution: true` postJS actions inside a hand-rolled eval sandbox whose `require` shim only resolved `./configLoader.js` and ids containing `scm.js`; every other id silently fell through to the `config.js` exports. Actions migrated to the tracker layer (`checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` → `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js`) therefore got the wrong module and died on the first member call — `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function` — killing the `story_ba_check` PO Review → BA Analysis hand-off on every SM pass, and pre-breaking every other localExecution rule (`retry_merge`, `bug_merged`, …).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` (`runLocalAction`): read the seven helper sources with the existing dual-read CWD pattern (`agents/js/common/<m>` → `js/common/<m>`) in dependency order — `ticketKeyShapes`, `trackers`, `tokenUsageComment`, `aiChat`, `validateInputJql`, `buildEncodedConfig`, `autoStart` — wrap each as its own sandbox module, and resolve their ids explicitly in a shared require shim before the `config.js` catch-all (kept for backwards compat). Unreadable helper → fail fast `Cannot read: <module>`; helper throwing at load → error names the module. `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`).

### Test Coverage

- New suite `smAgent: runLocalAction require shim (gh-908)` in `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js` (7 tests): tracker-layer resolution (UT-1), `agents/` layout (UT-1b/AC4), autoStart/aiChat/transitive chains (UT-2), unknown-id `config.js` fallback unchanged (UT-3/AC3), live `checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` end-to-end through the sandbox with mocked `jira_*` (IT-1), load-error naming (E3), unreadable-source fail-fast (E4).
- Reproduction confirmed RED before the fix (UT-1/UT-2/IT-1 failed with the live `not a function` signature), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — all green (result pinned in CI).

### Notes

- No behavior change outside `runLocalAction`: the sandbox catch-all still returns `config.js` exports for unknown ids (AC3), and the `scm.js`/`configLoader.js` handling is untouched.
- Known adjacent gap, intentionally not extended: `scm.js`'s own `require('./machineNotice.js')` still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. It is only reachable via `fetchDiscussions`, which no localExecution-reachable code calls today; the durable fix is route B (run localExecution actions through the normal module-dir-correct loader).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `localExecution: true` SM rule fails when its `postJSAction` requires a shared helper module — live on `story_ba_check`, whose PO Review → BA Analysis rung is dead on every SM pass with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function`.

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js` `runLocalAction` (lines 828–878) executes localExecution postJS modules in-process by reading their source and eval-ing it inside a hand-rolled sandbox. The sandbox pre-builds only three modules — `config.js` (`_cm`), `common/scm.js` (`_scm`), `configLoader.js` (`_cl`) — and the action-module `require` shim (lines 864–868) resolves **only** the exact ids `./configLoader.js`/`./configLoader` and any id containing `scm.js`. Every other id falls through the catch-all `return _cm.exports`, silently handing the action the `config.js` exports object. `js/checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` (migrated to the tracker layer in 2db92c99/ebc54801) requires `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js` at lines 17–18; both ids hit the catch-all, so `trackersModule.createTracker` is `undefined` and the first member call throws at line 28. The same silent-fallthrough applies to the whole verified require closure of the 13 postJS scripts behind the 15 localExecution rules: `common/trackers.js`, `common/tokenUsageComment.js`, `common/ticketKeyShapes.js` (transitive), `common/autoStart.js`, `common/aiChat.js`, `common/buildEncodedConfig.js` (transitive), `common/validateInputJql.js` (transitive). The catch-all also swallows typo'd require ids — the failure only surfaces at first member call, which is why it is silent at load time.

**Impact**: `story_ba_check` never moves PO Review stories to BA Analysis (SM logs `❌ Local execution failed for <KEY>` at `js/smAgent.js:1022`); the remaining localExecution rules (`retry_merge`, `retry_merge_test`, `bug_merged`, …) fail on the same path as soon as they fire. {"content":"### Root Cause

`runLocalAction` in `js/smAgent.js` executes `localExecution: true` postJS actions inside a hand-rolled eval sandbox whose `require` shim only resolved `./configLoader.js` and ids containing `scm.js`; every other id silently fell through to the `config.js` exports. {"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `localExecution: true` SM rule fails when its `postJSAction` requires a shared helper module — live on `story_ba_check`, whose PO Review → BA Analysis rung is dead on every SM pass with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function`.

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js` `runLocalAction` (lines 828–878) executes localExecution postJS modules in-process by reading their source and eval-ing it inside a hand-rolled sandbox. The sandbox pre-builds only three modules — `config.js` (`_cm`), `common/scm.js` (`_scm`), `configLoader.js` (`_cl`) — and the action-module `require` shim (lines 864–868) resolves **only** the exact ids `./configLoader.js`/`./configLoader` and any id containing `scm.js`. Every other id falls through the catch-all `return _cm.exports`, silently handing the action the `config.js` exports object. `js/checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` (migrated to the tracker layer in 2db92c99/ebc54801) requires `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js` at lines 17–18; both ids hit the catch-all, so `trackersModule.createTracker` is `undefined` and the first member call throws at line 28. The same silent-fallthrough applies to the whole verified require closure of the 13 postJS scripts behind the 15 localExecution rules: `common/trackers.js`, `common/tokenUsageComment.js`, `common/ticketKeyShapes.js` (transitive), `common/autoStart.js`, `common/aiChat.js`, `common/buildEncodedConfig.js` (transitive), `common/validateInputJql.js` (transitive). The catch-all also swallows typo'd require ids — the failure only surfaces at first member call, which is why it is silent at load time.

**Impact**: `story_ba_check` never moves PO Review stories to BA Analysis (SM logs `❌ Local execution failed for <KEY>` at `js/smAgent.js:1022`); the remaining localExecution rules (`retry_merge`, `retry_merge_test`, `bug_merged`, …) fail on the same path as soon as they fire. No non-localExecution behavior is affected.

**Fix approach** (route A from the ticket — extend the sandbox, minimal diff): in `runLocalAction`, read the seven helper sources with the same dual-read CWD fallback pattern already used for `config.js`/`scm.js` (`agents/js/common/<m>` then `js/common/<m>`), in dependency order (`ticketKeyShapes.js`, `trackers.js`, `tokenUsageComment.js`, `aiChat.js`, `validateInputJql.js`, `buildEncodedConfig.js`, `autoStart.js`); wrap each as its own `(function(module, exports, require){…})` module with a shared require shim; extend the action require shim with a substring check per helper **before** the `_cm.exports` catch-all (which stays for backwards compat). Unmatched ids keep receiving `config.js` exports; an unreadable helper source fails fast with `Cannot read: <module>` like the existing guards; a helper that throws at load surfaces an error naming the module.

**Scope decisions**:
- `aiChat` + `autoStart`/`buildEncodedConfig`/`validateInputJql` ship in the same change as the tracker trio (ticket open question 1 — 7 reads + wrapper blocks, no added risk).
- `scm.js`'s own require of `./machineNotice.js` (gh-808) still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. Not extended: `machineNotice` is only used by `scm.fetchDiscussions`, and no localExecution-reachable code path calls `fetchDiscussions` (its callers are preCli/post scripts that run through the normal module-dir-correct loader). Recorded here as an adjacent gap for route B (drop the sandbox, use the real loader).
- `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`) — it had zero unit-test coverage.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`runLocalAction` in `js/smAgent.js` executes `localExecution: true` postJS actions inside a hand-rolled eval sandbox whose `require` shim only resolved `./configLoader.js` and ids containing `scm.js`; every other id silently fell through to the `config.js` exports. Actions migrated to the tracker layer (`checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` → `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js`) therefore got the wrong module and died on the first member call — `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function` — killing the `story_ba_check` PO Review → BA Analysis hand-off on every SM pass, and pre-breaking every other localExecution rule (`retry_merge`, `bug_merged`, …).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` (`runLocalAction`): read the seven helper sources with the existing dual-read CWD pattern (`agents/js/common/<m>` → `js/common/<m>`) in dependency order — `ticketKeyShapes`, `trackers`, `tokenUsageComment`, `aiChat`, `validateInputJql`, `buildEncodedConfig`, `autoStart` — wrap each as its own sandbox module, and resolve their ids explicitly in a shared require shim before the `config.js` catch-all (kept for backwards compat). Unreadable helper → fail fast `Cannot read: <module>`; helper throwing at load → error names the module. `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`).

### Test Coverage

- New suite `smAgent: runLocalAction require shim (gh-908)` in `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js` (7 tests): tracker-layer resolution (UT-1), `agents/` layout (UT-1b/AC4), autoStart/aiChat/transitive chains (UT-2), unknown-id `config.js` fallback unchanged (UT-3/AC3), live `checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` end-to-end through the sandbox with mocked `jira_*` (IT-1), load-error naming (E3), unreadable-source fail-fast (E4).
- Reproduction confirmed RED before the fix (UT-1/UT-2/IT-1 failed with the live `not a function` signature), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — all green (result pinned in CI).

### Notes

- No behavior change outside `runLocalAction`: the sandbox catch-all still returns `config.js` exports for unknown ids (AC3), and the `scm.js`/`configLoader.js` handling is untouched.
- Known adjacent gap, intentionally not extended: `scm.js`'s own `require('./machineNotice.js')` still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. It is only reachable via `fetchDiscussions`, which no localExecution-reachable code calls today; the durable fix is route B (run localExecution actions through the normal module-dir-correct loader).

blocks.text:
# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `localExecution: true` SM rule fails when its `postJSAction` requires a shared helper module — live on `story_ba_check`, whose PO Review → BA Analysis rung is dead on every SM pass with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function`.

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js` `runLocalAction` (lines 828–878) executes localExecution postJS modules in-process by reading their source and eval-ing it inside a hand-rolled sandbox. The sandbox pre-builds only three modules — `config.js` (`_cm`), `common/scm.js` (`_scm`), `configLoader.js` (`_cl`) — and the action-module `require` shim (lines 864–868) resolves **only** the exact ids `./configLoader.js`/`./configLoader` and any id containing `scm.js`. Every other id falls through the catch-all `return _cm.exports`, silently handing the action the `config.js` exports object. `js/checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` (migrated to the tracker layer in 2db92c99/ebc54801) requires `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js` at lines 17–18; both ids hit the catch-all, so `trackersModule.createTracker` is `undefined` and the first member call throws at line 28. The same silent-fallthrough applies to the whole verified require closure of the 13 postJS scripts behind the 15 localExecution rules: `common/trackers.js`, `common/tokenUsageComment.js`, `common/ticketKeyShapes.js` (transitive), `common/autoStart.js`, `common/aiChat.js`, `common/buildEncodedConfig.js` (transitive), `common/validateInputJql.js` (transitive). The catch-all also swallows typo'd require ids — the failure only surfaces at first member call, which is why it is silent at load time.

**Impact**: `story_ba_check` never moves PO Review stories to BA Analysis (SM logs `❌ Local execution failed for <KEY>` at `js/smAgent.js:1022`); the remaining localExecution rules (`retry_merge`, `retry_merge_test`, `bug_merged`, …) fail on the same path as soon as they fire. No non-localExecution behavior is affected.

...
4
### Root Cause

`runLocalAction` in `js/smAgent.js` executes `localExecution: true` postJS actions inside a hand-rolled eval sandbox whose `require` shim only resolved `./configLoader.js` and ids containing `scm.js`; every other id silently fell through to the `config.js` exports. Actions migrated to the tracker layer (`checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` → `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js`) therefore got the wrong module and died on the first member call — `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function` — killing the `story_ba_check` PO Review → BA Analysis hand-off on every SM pass, and pre-breaking every other localExecution rule (`retry_merge`, `bug_merged`, …).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `localExecution: true` SM rule fails when its `postJSAction` requires a shared helper module — live on `story_ba_check`, whose PO Review → BA Analysis rung is dead on every SM pass with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function`.

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js` `runLocalAction` (lines 828–878) executes localExecution postJS modules in-process by reading their source and eval-ing it inside a hand-rolled sandbox. The sandbox pre-builds only three modules — `config.js` (`_cm`), `common/scm.js` (`_scm`), `configLoader.js` (`_cl`) — and the action-module `require` shim (lines 864–868) resolves **only** the exact ids `./configLoader.js`/`./configLoader` and any id containing `scm.js`. Every other id falls through the catch-all `return _cm.exports`, silently handing the action the `config.js` exports object. `js/checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` (migrated to the tracker layer in 2db92c99/ebc54801) requires `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js` at lines 17–18; both ids hit the catch-all, so `trackersModule.createTracker` is `undefined` and the first member call throws at line 28. The same silent-fallthrough applies to the whole verified require closure of the 13 postJS scripts behind the 15 localExecution rules: `common/trackers.js`, `common/tokenUsageComment.js`, `common/ticketKeyShapes.js` (transitive), `common/autoStart.js`, `common/aiChat.js`, `common/buildEncodedConfig.js` (transitive), `common/validateInputJql.js` (transitive). The catch-all also swallows typo'd require ids — the failure only surfaces at first member call, which is why it is silent at load time.

**Impact**: `story_ba_check` never moves PO Review stories to BA Analysis (SM logs `❌ Local execution failed for <KEY>` at `js/smAgent.js:1022`); the remaining localExecution rules (`retry_merge`, `retry_merge_test`, `bug_merged`, …) fail on the same path as soon as they fire. No non-localExecution behavior is affected.

**Fix approach** (route A from the ticket — extend the sandbox, minimal diff): in `runLocalAction`, read the seven helper sources with the same dual-read CWD fallback pattern already used for `config.js`/`scm.js` (`agents/js/common/<m>` then `js/common/<m>`), in dependency order (`ticketKeyShapes.js`, `trackers.js`, `tokenUsageComment.js`, `aiChat.js`, `validateInputJql.js`, `buildEncodedConfig.js`, `autoStart.js`); wrap each as its own `(function(module, exports, require){…})` module with a shared require shim; extend the action require shim with a substring check per helper **before** the `_cm.exports` catch-all (which stays for backwards compat). Unmatched ids keep receiving `config.js` exports; an unreadable helper source fails fast with `Cannot read: <module>` like the existing guards; a helper that throws at load surfaces an error naming the module.

**Scope decisions**:
- `aiChat` + `autoStart`/`buildEncodedConfig`/`validateInputJql` ship in the same change as the tracker trio (ticket open question 1 — 7 reads + wrapper blocks, no added risk).
- `scm.js`'s own require of `./machineNotice.js` (gh-808) still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. Not extended: `machineNotice` is only used by `scm.fetchDiscussions`, and no localExecution-reachable code path calls `fetchDiscussions` (its callers are preCli/post scripts that run through the normal module-dir-correct loader). Recorded here as an adjacent gap for route B (drop the sandbox, use the real loader).
- `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`) — it had zero unit-test coverage.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket.
"}

{"content":"### Root Cause

`runLocalAction` in `js/smAgent.js` executes `localExecution: true` postJS actions inside a hand-rolled eval sandbox whose `require` shim only resolved `./configLoader.js` and ids containing `scm.js`; every other id silently fell through to the `config.js` exports. Actions migrated to the tracker layer (`checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` → `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js`) therefore got the wrong module and died on the first member call — `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function` — killing the `story_ba_check` PO Review → BA Analysis hand-off on every SM pass, and pre-breaking every other localExecution rule (`retry_merge`, `bug_merged`, …).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` (`runLocalAction`): read the seven helper sources with the existing dual-read CWD pattern (`agents/js/common/<m>` → `js/common/<m>`) in dependency order — `ticketKeyShapes`, `trackers`, `tokenUsageComment`, `aiChat`, `validateInputJql`, `buildEncodedConfig`, `autoStart` — wrap each as its own sandbox module, and resolve their ids explicitly in a shared require shim before the `config.js` catch-all (kept for backwards compat). Unreadable helper → fail fast `Cannot read: <module>`; helper throwing at load → error names the module. `runLocalAction` is now exported for tests (same pattern as `applyRuleOverridesForTest`).

### Test Coverage

- New suite `smAgent: runLocalAction require shim (gh-908)` in `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js` (7 tests): tracker-layer resolution (UT-1), `agents/` layout (UT-1b/AC4), autoStart/aiChat/transitive chains (UT-2), unknown-id `config.js` fallback unchanged (UT-3/AC3), live `checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` end-to-end through the sandbox with mocked `jira_*` (IT-1), load-error naming (E3), unreadable-source fail-fast (E4).
- Reproduction confirmed RED before the fix (UT-1/UT-2/IT-1 failed with the live `not a function` signature), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — all green (result pinned in CI).

### Notes

- No behavior change outside `runLocalAction`: the sandbox catch-all still returns `config.js` exports for unknown ids (AC3), and the `scm.js`/`configLoader.js` handling is untouched.
- Known adjacent gap, intentionally not extended: `scm.js`'s own `require('./machineNotice.js')` still resolves to `config.js` exports inside the sandbox. It is only reachable via `fetchDiscussions`, which no localExecution-reachable code calls today; the durable fix is route B (run localExecution actions through the normal module-dir-correct loader).

# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `localExecution: true` SM rule fails when its `postJSAction` requires a shared helper module — live on `story_ba_check`, whose PO Review → BA Analysis rung is dead on every SM pass with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function`.

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js` `runLocalAction` (lines 828–878) executes localExecution postJS modules in-process by reading their source and eval-ing it inside a hand-rolled sandbox. The sandbox pre-builds only three modules — `config.js` (`_cm`), `common/scm.js` (`_scm`), `configLoader.js` (`_cl`) — and the action-module `require` shim (lines 864–868) resolves **only** the exact ids `./configLoader.js`/`./configLoader` and any id containing `scm.js`. Every other id falls through the catch-all `return _cm.exports`, silently handing the action the `config.js` exports object. `js/checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` (migrated to the tracker layer in 2db92c99/ebc54801) requires `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js` at lines 17–18; both ids hit the catch-all, so `trackersModule.createTracker` is `undefined` and the first member call throws at line 28. The same silent-fallthrough applies to the whole verified require closure of the 13 postJS scripts behind the 15 localExecution rules: `common/trackers.js`, `common/tokenUsageComment.js`, `common/ticketKeyShapes.js` (transitive), `common/autoStart.js`, `common/aiChat.js`, `common/buildEncodedConfig.js` (transitive), `common/validateInputJql.js` (transitive). The catch-all also swallows typo'd require ids — the failure only surfaces at first member call, which is why it is silent at load time.

**Impact**: `story_ba_check` never moves PO Review stories to BA Analysis (SM logs `❌ Local execution failed for <KEY>` at `js/smAgent.js:1022`); the remaining localExecution rules (`retry_merge`, `retry_merge_test`, `bug_merged`, …) fail on the same path as soon as they fire. No non-localExecution behavior is affected.

`runLocalAction` in `js/smAgent.js` executes `localExecution: true` postJS actions inside a hand-rolled eval sandbox whose `require` shim only resolved `./configLoader.js` and ids containing `scm.js`; every other id silently fell through to the `config.js` exports. Actions migrated to the tracker layer (`checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` → `./common/trackers.js` + `./common/tokenUsageComment.js`) therefore got the wrong module and died on the first member call — `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function` — killing the `story_ba_check` PO Review → BA Analysis hand-off on every SM pass, and pre-breaking every other localExecution rule (`retry_merge`, `bug_merged`, …).

All checks pass. Work complete — final summary:

## gh-908 — `runLocalAction` require shim fix (route A)

**Root cause:** `runLocalAction` (`js/smAgent.js`) evals localExecution postJS actions in a sandbox whose `require` shim resolved only `configLoader.js`/`scm.js` ids; everything else silently got `config.js` exports. Tracker-layer requires (`./common/trackers.js`, `./common/tokenUsageComment.js`) in `checkSubtasksDoneForBA.js` therefore exploded with `TypeError: trackersModule.createTracker is not a function` — `story_ba_check`'s PO Review → BA Analysis rung dead on every SM pass, and the same latent failure in all 15 localExecution rules.

**Fix (TDD):** RCA first → reproduction suite written and confirmed **RED** (6 tests failing with the live `not a function` signature) → minimal sandbox extension: the 7 helper modules are read with the existing dual-read CWD pattern in dependency order, wrapped as sandbox modules, and resolved by explicit substring checks in a shared shim placed **before** the untouched `config.js` catch-all (AC3 compat pinned by UT-3). Fail-fast `Cannot read:` guards (E4) and module-named load errors (E3) included. `runLocalAction` exported for tests (had zero coverage). Full suite green: **2800 passed, 0 failed**; smAgent suite 523/0. The harness auto-saved the bulk as WIP commit `cadb14f` on `ai/gh-908`; the final 4-line test delta remains for post-processing, per the bug-development flow. Deliverables: `outputs/rca.md`, `outputs/response.md`.

One deviation to note for the reviewer: E3/E4 initially failed post-fix because the test harness's `fileReadMock` strips `agents/` prefixes to real disk before consulting `fileMap` — fixed by pinning both path variants in the tests (4-line edit, verified in the final green runs).
